#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Create a team meeting ICS event for next Wednesday at 3 PM, 1 hour duration."""
import datetime as dt
import uuid

# Try zoneinfo (Python 3.9+), fall back to pytz
try:
    from zoneinfo import ZoneInfo
    TZ = ZoneInfo("UTC")
    now = dt.datetime.now(TZ)
except ImportError:
    import pytz
    TZ = pytz.UTC
    now = dt.datetime.now(TZ)

# Determine "next Wednesday": the next Wednesday strictly after today
today = now.date()
days_ahead = (2 - today.weekday()) % 7  # Wednesday == 2
if days_ahead == 0:
    days_ahead = 7  # if today is Wednesday, go to next week's Wednesday
next_wed = today + dt.timedelta(days=days_ahead)

start = dt.datetime(next_wed.year, next_wed.month, next_wed.day, 15, 0, 0, tzinfo=TZ)
end = start + dt.timedelta(hours=1)
stamp = now

uid = f"{uuid.uuid4()}@workspace"

ics_lines = [
    "BEGIN:VCALENDAR",
    "VERSION:2.0",
    "PRODID:-//Workspace//Calendar Skill//EN",
    "CALSCALE:GREGORIAN",
    "METHOD:PUBLISH",
    "BEGIN:VEVENT",
    f"UID:{uid}",
    f"DTSTAMP:{stamp.strftime('%Y%m%dT%H%M%SZ')}",
    f"DTSTART:{start.strftime('%Y%m%dT%H%M%SZ')}",
    f"DTEND:{end.strftime('%Y%m%dT%H%M%SZ')}",
    "SUMMARY:Team Meeting",
    "DESCRIPTION:Team meeting scheduled for next Wednesday at 3 PM (1 hour).",
    "STATUS:CONFIRMED",
    "SEQUENCE:0",
    "TRANSP:OPAQUE",
    "BEGIN:VALARM",
    "ACTION:DISPLAY",
    "DESCRIPTION:Team meeting starts in 15 minutes.",
    "TRIGGER:-PT15M",
    "END:VALARM",
    "END:VEVENT",
    "END:VCALENDAR",
]

with open("team_meeting.ics", "w", encoding="utf-8", newline="\r\n") as f:
    f.write("\n".join(ics_lines) + "\n")

print(f"Today: {today.isoformat()} ({today.strftime('%A')})")
print(f"Next Wednesday: {next_wed.isoformat()}")
print(f"Event start (UTC): {start.isoformat()}")
print(f"Event end (UTC):   {end.isoformat()}")
print(f"UID: {uid}")
print("Wrote team_meeting.ics")

# Validate: re-parse the generated file
try:
    from icalendar import Calendar
    with open("team_meeting.ics", "rb") as f:
        cal = Calendar.from_ical(f.read())
    events = [c for c in cal.walk() if c.name == "VEVENT"]
    assert len(events) == 1, "Expected exactly one VEVENT"
    ev = events[0]
    assert str(ev.get("summary")) == "Team Meeting"
    assert ev.get("dtstart").dt == start
    assert ev.get("dtend").dt == end
    print("Validation: PASSED (valid ICS, 1 event, correct start/end)")
except ImportError:
    print("Validation: skipped (icalendar library not installed)")
